synopsis: "Hey Kuroya-kun, you like me, right?" "H-How did you know!?" For an introverted high school boy like Kuroya, revealing his unrequited love would be an embarrassment worse than death. Especially when his crush is a beautiful, popular girl like Kasumi Shiramori, his senpai in the Literature Club. Even though they spend time together in the Literature Club, he had tried to keep his feelings hidden, until now...! Senpai asks the despairing Kuroya, "So── for now, as a trial, would you like to go out with me?" No way. I didn't think it was possible to have a relationship with her!? This can't really be happening── It's a romantic comedy full of sweet flirtation and sadistic teasing from the senpai of your dreams! synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito!
